description: Spec §7.1: SetEnds(origin + (0, 0, 100), origin + (1000, 0, 100)) on a BP_DFFxTracer puts it at Start aimed at End with the beam 1000 cm long: its world bounds are 950-1050 cm in X, centred at +500 +- 25 cm. Kept alive (Lifetime and life span 10 s) and ticking before the test, 0.5 s later it has ticked (Age > 0) and still spans the shot: Tick scales from the base SetEnds updated, not the 1 m beam it was spawned with.
